title: σ-Hereditarily Closure-Preserving I-sn-Networks, I-sn-Metrizability, and Local HCP-Finiteness
content: For every admissible ideal \(\mathcal{I}\) on \(\mathbb{N}\), we prove that every regular space with a \(\sigma\)-hereditarily closure-preserving (HCP) \(\mathcal{I}\)-\(sn\)-network is \(\mathcal{I}\)-\(sn\)-metrizable, answering Problem~5.2 of Zhou--Liu--Liu--Lin. The proof combines existing characterizations with a local countability bound. If \(y_n\to_{\mathcal{I}} x\) in a space \(X\) and \(\{n:y_n\ne x\}\in\mathcal{I}^{+}\), then every point-discrete family of \(\mathcal{I}\)-sequential neighborhoods of \(x\) is countable. If no such sequence exists at \(x\), then \(\{x\}\) itself is an \(\mathcal{I}\)-sequential neighborhood. These alternatives imply that every space with a \(\sigma\)-point-discrete \(\mathcal{I}\)-\(sn\)-network is \(\mathcal{I}\)-\(snf\)-countable.We say that \(\mathcal{I}\) has local HCP-finiteness if, in every \(T_1\) space, the convergence and support assumptions above imply that each HCP family of \(\mathcal{I}\)-sequential neighborhoods of \(x\) is finite. A countable Rudin--Keisler antichain of free ultrafilters gives an admissible ideal without this property, so the countability bound cannot in general be strengthened to finiteness. Every \(\mathfrak{p}^{-}\) ideal has local HCP-finiteness. We give sufficient conditions for Fubini products, heterogeneous Fubini sums, and increasing unions to preserve this property. These results establish local HCP-finiteness for the finite Fubini powers of \(\mathrm{Fin}\), Kat\v{e}tov's first limit-stage ideal \(\mathrm{Fin}^\omega\) and its finite successors, the tree-derived rank-\(\omega\) ideal \(\mathcal{H}_{<\omega}\), and the inductive-limit ideal \(\mathrm{Fin}_\omega\). All these examples except \(\mathrm{Fin}\) fail \(\mathfrak{p}^{-}\).
